title: Particles 8: Mixed Review
description: A capstone review of the whole track: choosing the right particle (же, ведь, ли, разве, неужели, -то, вот) by the speaker's intent, distinguishing the close pairs, placing the leaning particles correctly, and producing the forms yourself by translating from intent. The hardest skill is picking the function, not translating a word.
descriptionRussian: Итоговое повторение всего трека: выбор нужной частицы (же, ведь, ли, разве, неужели, -то, вот) по намерению говорящего, различение близких пар, правильное место частиц и самостоятельное построение фраз по смыслу. Самое трудное — выбрать функцию, а не перевести слово.
intro: Choose by intent, never by an English word, because most of these have no English word. Underline, appeal, question, doubt, astonish, spotlight, or point. Get the intent right and the particle follows; get the position right and it lands where you meant. That is the whole of it, and it is what makes written Russian sound spoken.
rules: Choose the particle by the speaker's intent, not by an English word: emphasize/insist → же; appeal to shared knowledge → ведь; ask yes-no / 'whether' → ли; disbelief → разве (doubt) or неужели (astonishment); spotlight/concede → emphatic -то; point/present → вот.
же vs ведь: же is the sharp emotional underline ('I TOLD you!'); ведь is the soft reasoning appeal ('I did tell you, you know'). If 'after all / you know' fits, use ведь.
разве vs неужели: разве leans doubt/challenge expecting 'no'; неужели leans pure astonishment and can stand alone (Неужели?!). Neither combines with ли.
ли vs если: ли = embedded 'whether' (не знаю, придёт ли он); если = conditional 'if' (если придёт). Emphatic -то spotlights a content word; indefinite -то builds кто-то/где-то.
Placement: же and ли lean on the word before them and never start a clause, sitting in second position after the focused word; ведь, вот, разве, неужели are freer and often lead.
examples: Я же сказал тебе! (I TOLD you!) sharp emphatic reminder = же.
Он ведь устал, дай ему отдохнуть. (He's tired, after all; let him rest.) shared-knowledge appeal = ведь.
Я не знаю, успеем ли мы. (I don't know whether we'll make it.) embedded 'whether' = ли.
Неужели ты сам это починил?! (Did you really fix this yourself?!) astonishment = неужели.
Денег-то хватит, а вот времени мало. (Money we'll have enough of, but time is short.) emphatic -то spotlights, вот points.
Вот в чём вопрос. (That is the question.) вот marks the point.

rows.label: Point / present
cells: Вот он! / Вот в чём дело.

items.prompt: Embed a yes-no question: 'I don't know whether we'll make it in time.' Я не знаю, _____ мы вовремя.
items.promptEnglish: I don't know whether we'll make it in time.
items.hint: Embedded 'whether' uses ли on the fronted verb; not если.
items.explanation: An embedded yes-no question takes ли on the fronted verb: успеем ли мы.Если is conditional 'if' and wrong for 'whether'; же would emphasize, not question; разве would add disbelief.Ли is the only embedding particle for a yes-no clause.

items.prompt: Soft appeal to shared knowledge: 'He's tired, after all; let him rest.' Он _____ устал, дай ему отдохнуть.
items.promptEnglish: He's tired, after all; let him rest.
items.hint: Which particle frames an obvious, shared reason ('after all')?
items.explanation: ведь frames 'he's tired' as accepted, shared grounds ('after all'), softly justifying the request.Ли would form a question, разве would add disbelief ('surely he's not tired?'), вот would point. The reasoning, common-ground appeal is ведь.

items.prompt: React with pure amazement: '_____ ты сам всё починил?!'
items.promptEnglish: Did you really fix it all yourself?!
items.hint: Astonishment at an impressive, barely-believable feat.
items.explanation: Неужели carries the astonished, incredulous reaction to an impressive feat ('you really did it all yourself?!').Ли asks neutrally; же emphasizes; вот points.Неужели is the particle of pure amazement here, and it could even stand alone as Неужели?!

items.prompt: Sharp reproach, 'I TOLD you!' (not the soft 'you know'). Я _____ говорил!
items.hint: The sharp emotional underline is же; the soft reasoning version is ведь.
items.explanation: Я же говорил!Is the sharp, impatient 'I TOLD you!' же is the emotional underline.Ведь would soften it to the reasoning 'I did tell you, you know.' ли would form a question and вот would point. For a sharp reproach, же.

items.prompt: Point at and present an arrival: 'Here he is, finally!' _____ и он, наконец!
items.hint: Which free-standing word presents and points at what appears?
items.explanation: вот presents and points at what appears: Вот и он! = 'here he is!' It stands free at the front.Ли would form a question, же leans on a word and cannot lead, разве would add disbelief. The presenting, pointing job is вот's.

items.prompt: Concede before a 'but': 'Understand it I did, but I disagree.' _____ я понял, но не согласен.
items.promptEnglish: Understand it I did, but I disagree.
items.hint: The concessive rhythm verb + -то ..., но ... grants one point first.
items.explanation: Понять-то я понял, но не согласен uses the concessive verb + -то ..., но ...Pattern, granting the point ('understand it I did') before objecting. This is the emphatic -то clinging to a content word.Ли would question, вот would point, разве would doubt; none gives the concessive rhythm.

items.prompt: Which sentence is INCORRECT? (Watch the placement and stacking rules.)
items.hint: разве and неужели never combine with ли.
items.explanation: Разве пришёл ли он?Is wrong: разве already turns the statement into a charged question, so adding ли is ungrammatical. The other three are fine: Разве он пришёл? (disbelief), Пришёл ли он? (neutral yes-no), Он ведь пришёл (shared-knowledge statement). Never stack разве/неужели with ли.

items.hint: The sharp reproach particle, leaning on я.
items.explanation: The emphatic reproach is же after the subject: Я же говорил тебе! Бы would make it hypothetical; the infinitive cannot carry the clause; ли would turn it into a question.

items.promptEnglish: He's tired, after all; let him rest.
items.explanation: Ведь offers the obvious reason: он ведь устал. Же ли and вот ли stack particles illegally; the infinitive cannot serve as the predicate.

items.promptEnglish: I don't know whether we'll make it on time.
items.explanation: The embedded question fronts the verb and adds ли: не знаю, сможем ли мы. Ли never leads its clause; если is conditional; же asserts.

items.promptEnglish: Did you really do it yourself?! (astonishment)
items.hint: Pure astonishment at an impressive feat.
items.explanation: Неужели leads the amazed question: Неужели ты сам это сделал?! Разве would color it with doubt or challenge; ведь asserts; ли же stacks illegally.

items.promptEnglish: Read it I did, but I disagree.
items.explanation: The concessive rhythm doubles the verb with -то on the fronted infinitive: Прочитать-то я прочитал, но... Же, ли, and вот cannot set up this concession.

blanks: Это _____ та самая улица, где мы жили в детстве. (This is the very same street where we lived as children.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: After the demonstrative та, же delivers identity: та же (самая) улица = 'the very same street.' ли would form a question, ведь appeals to shared knowledge, вот points. The 'the very same' meaning belongs to же after a demonstrative.
hints: Which particle, placed after the demonstrative та, gives the meaning 'the very same'?
explanations: же after the demonstrative та expresses identity: та же (самая) улица = 'the very same street.' This is the identity job of же with demonstratives. ли would form a question, ведь would appeal to shared knowledge, and вот would point at something; only же delivers 'the very same' here.

errorCorrection.sentence: Я ведь предупреждал тебя об этом, а ты меня не послушал!
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: I warned you about this, didn't I, and you didn't listen to me!
errorCorrection.explanation: The sharp, reproachful 'I warned you, didn't I!' is the job of же: Я же предупреждал тебя. The gloss's accusing tone ('and you didn't listen') matches же's emotional underline rather than ведь's soft, calm 'after all, you know.' вот is a pointer and carries no reproach.Ли is the yes-no question particle, but this is an emphatic statement, not a question.

errorCorrection.sentence: Скажи мне, если ты будешь свободен завтра вечером.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Tell me whether you will be free tomorrow evening.
errorCorrection.explanation: This is an embedded yes-no question ('tell me whether you will be free'), which Russian renders with ли and the verb fronted: Скажи, будешь ли ты свободен.Если means conditional 'if' (Скажи, если будешь свободен = 'tell me in the event that you are free'), a different meaning the gloss does not intend.Ли ты будешь свободен is the wrong order because ли leans on the word before it and cannot lead the embedded clause; будешь comes first, then ли.Разве ты будешь свободен would form a disbelief question, not a neutral embedded one.

errorCorrection.sentence: Разве мы наконец-то выиграли главный приз, поверить не могу!
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Did we really finally win the grand prize? I can't believe it!
errorCorrection.explanation: неужели expresses pure astonishment at something wonderful and hard to believe: Неужели мы выиграли?!Matches the elated 'I can't believe it' of the gloss.Разве leans toward doubt and challenge, usually expecting 'no,' which clashes with the speaker's joyful, accepting surprise. Ведь would turn it into a reasoning statement rather than an amazed question. Же leans on a word and cannot begin the clause here.

minimalPairs.context: Я _____ говорил. (Goal: the SOFT 'I did tell you, you know', appealing to reason.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I did tell you, you know.
minimalPairs.explanation: ведь gives the calm, reasoning 'I did tell you, you know,' appealing to shared knowledge.Же would make it the sharp 'I TOLD you!' Same words, different temperature: ведь explains, же presses. The English 'you know / after all' points you to ведь.

minimalPairs.context: _____ он придёт? (Goal: doubt/challenge, 'He'll come? Really? I doubt it.')
minimalPairs.explanation: разве injects doubt and challenge: Разве он придёт? = 'he'll come? I don't think so.' Ли would only ask neutrally (Придёт ли он? = 'will he come?') with no skepticism. The doubting, expecting-'no' flavor is разве's.

patternRecognition.sentence: Денег-то хватит, а вот времени у нас мало.
patternRecognition.question: What two particle jobs appear here?
options: Emphatic -то spotlights and concedes one point; вот presents the contrasting point
patternRecognition.answer: Emphatic -то spotlights and concedes one point; вот presents the contrasting point
patternRecognition.explanation: Денег-то хватит uses emphatic -то clinging to денег to spotlight and concede it ('money we'll have enough of'), and а вот... presents the contrasting point ('but time, now, is short'), where free-standing вот spotlights what follows. So this is the concessive -то plus a presenting вот, two separate jobs, not the indefinite suffix, not stacked reminders, and not a disbelief question.

patternRecognition.sentence: Куда же ты так спешишь? Неужели опаздываешь?
patternRecognition.question: Identify the jobs of же and неужели.
options: же emphasizes the question word; неужели adds astonishment/disbelief
patternRecognition.answer: же emphasizes the question word; неужели adds astonishment/disbelief
patternRecognition.explanation: же clips into second position to intensify the question word куда ('where on earth are you rushing?'), while неужели leads the second sentence with astonishment ('surely you're not late?!'). This shows the two groups working together: же leaning on the word before it in second position, and the free неужели at the front.

sentenceBuilding.translation: You know this, after all (you know).
sentenceBuilding.hint: Soft appeal to shared knowledge: ведь sits after the opening subject ты.
sentenceBuilding.explanation: ведь appeals to shared knowledge ('you know this, after all'). It is free but most natural right after the opening ты: Ты ведь это знаешь. The tone is the calm reasoning appeal, not a sharp reproach.

sentenceBuilding.hint: Neutral yes-no question: front the verb, then the leaning particle ли.
sentenceBuilding.explanation: A neutral yes-no question fronts the verb and follows it with ли: Придёт ли он? ли leans on придёт and can never start the clause, so the verb leads. This is the bookish, neutral way to ask 'will he come?'

sentenceBuilding.hint: Point at and present something: the free-standing pointer leads.
sentenceBuilding.explanation: вот presents and points: Вот наш дом = 'here is our house.' It stands free at the front of the clause, unlike же and ли, which lean on a preceding word. вот is the pointing/presenting particle.

reviewVocab.definition: же = sharp emphatic reminder or 'the very same' (Я же говорил! / тот же); ведь = soft appeal to shared knowledge ('after all, you know'). же leans on the word before it; ведь is free.
reviewVocab.example: Я же говорил! vs Он ведь устал.

reviewVocab.definition: ли = neutral yes-no or embedded 'whether' (Придёт ли он? / не знаю, успеем ли мы); разве = doubt/challenge expecting 'no'; неужели = pure astonishment, can stand alone (Неужели?!).
reviewVocab.example: Придёт ли он? / Разве сегодня вторник? / Неужели ты сам это сделал?!

reviewVocab.definition: emphatic -то clings to a content word to spotlight or concede it (Погода-то...! / Сделать-то сделал, но...); вот stands free and points at or presents what follows (Вот наш дом. / Вот в чём дело.).
reviewVocab.example: Денег-то хватит, а вот времени мало.
